f.title: Suspend research immediately on risk of serious injury, disability or death
f.statement: Research on human beings shall be suspended immediately by the principal investigator if a risk of serious injury, disability or death of the research subject arises, and also when the subject so requests.
f.clause: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 14, fracción IX

rows.quote:
IX. Deberá ser suspendida la investigación de inmediato por el investigador principal, en el caso de
       sobrevenir el riesgo de lesiones graves, discapacidad o muerte del sujeto en quien se realice la
       investigación, así como cuando éste lo solicite, y
rows.location: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 14, fracción IX
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'Deberá ser suspendida ... de inmediato' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. rows.quote_en: IX. The research shall be suspended immediately by the principal investigator if a risk of serious injury, disability or death of the subject on whom the research is carried out arises, and also when the subject so requests; and

f.title: Provide medical care to subjects harmed by the research
f.statement: The health-care institution in which the research is carried out is responsible for providing medical care to a research subject who suffers harm directly related to the research, without prejudice to any legally due compensation.
f.clause: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 14, fracción X
f.applicability: Harm directly related to the research

rows.actor: Health-care institution where the research is carried out
rows.quote:
X.   Será responsabilidad de la institución de atención a la salud en la que se realice la investigación
        proporcionar atención médica al sujeto de investigación que sufra algún daño, si estuviere
        relacionado directamente con la investigación, sin perjuicio de la indemnización que legalmente
        corresponda.
rows.location: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 14, fracción X
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'Será responsabilidad' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'Será responsabilidad de la institución' = Mandatory allocation with explicit actor; statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: X. The health-care institution in which the research is carried out shall be responsible for providing medical care to the research subject who suffers any harm, if directly related to the research, without prejudice to any legally due compensation.

f.title: Take measures to avoid risk or harm to research subjects in multi-group designs
f.statement: When the experimental design includes several groups, random selection methods shall be used for impartial allocation and appropriate measures shall be taken to avoid any risk or harm to research subjects.

rows.quote:
ARTICULO 15.- Cuando el diseño experimental de una investigación que se realice en seres
humanos incluya varios grupos, se usarán métodos aleatorios de selección para obtener una asignación
imparcial de los participantes en cada grupo y deberán tomarse las medidas pertinentes para evitar
cualquier riesgo o daño a los sujetos de investigación.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'se usarán' (future imperative) and 'deberán tomarse' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'se usarán' / 'deberán tomarse' = Mandatory. Below 90: actor inferred (impersonal passive).
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 15.- When the experimental design of research carried out on human beings includes several groups, random selection methods will be used to obtain impartial allocation of participants to each group, and appropriate measures shall be taken to avoid any risk or harm to research subjects.

f.title: Commit to give subjects updated information obtained during the study
f.statement: As part of the explanation required for valid informed consent, the subject or legal representative shall be told of the commitment to provide updated information obtained during the study, even if it might affect the subject's willingness to continue participating.
f.clause: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 21, fracción IX

rows.quote:
IX. El compromiso de proporcionarle información actualizada obtenida durante el estudio aunque ésta
pudiera afectar la voluntad del sujeto para continuar participando;
rows.location: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 21, fracción IX
rows.review_note: Review: no change; operative lead-in is Art 21 ('deberá recibir una explicación'), stated in the statement. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Below 90: list item; operative lead-in of Art 21 ('deberá recibir una explicación') lies outside the quote; actor (principal investigator) inferred.
rows.quote_en: IX. The commitment to provide him or her with updated information obtained during the study even though it might affect the subject's willingness to continue participating;

f.title: Supervise and suspend greater-than-minimal-risk research in minors on risk
f.statement: For research in minors or incapacitated persons with greater than minimal risk and no direct benefit, the head of the health-care institution establishes strict supervision to determine whether the magnitude of foreseen risks increases or new risks arise, and suspends the research when the risk could affect the biological, psychological or social well-being of the minor or incapacitated person.
f.clause: Título Segundo, Capítulo III, Artículo 39, fracción II, inciso B
f.applicability: Research in minors or incapacitated persons, greater than minimal risk, without direct benefit

rows.quote:
B). El titular de la institución de atención a la salud establecerá una supervisión estricta para
determinar si aumenta la magnitud de los riesgos previstos o surgen otros y suspenderá la investigación
en el momento en que el riesgo pudiera afectar el bienestar biológico, psicológico o social del menor o del
incapaz.
rows.location: Título Segundo, Capítulo III, Artículo 39, fracción II, inciso B
rows.review_note: Review: no change; future imperatives 'establecerá ... suspenderá' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit. Below 90: future-tense imperatives ('establecerá', 'suspenderá') rather than 'deberá'; the conditions (minors, greater than minimal risk, no direct benefit) come from the lead-in outside the quote.
rows.quote_en: B). The head of the health-care institution will establish strict supervision to determine whether the magnitude of the foreseen risks increases or others arise, and will suspend the research at the moment the risk could affect the biological, psychological or social well-being of the minor or incapacitated person.

f.title: Exclude pregnancy and minimise pregnancy risk in higher-risk research
f.statement: In research classified as greater than minimal risk in women of childbearing age, measures shall be taken to certify that the women are not pregnant before accepting them as subjects and to reduce as far as possible the probability of pregnancy during the research.
f.applicability: Women of childbearing age in greater than minimal risk research

rows.quote:
ARTICULO 42.- En las investigaciones clasificadas como de riesgo mayor que el mínimo, que se
realicen en mujeres en edad fértil, deberán tomarse medidas para:

   I. Certificar que las mujeres no están embarazadas, previamente a su aceptación como sujetos de
investigación, y

    II. Disminuir en lo posible las probabilidades de embarazo durante el desarrollo de la investigación.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'deberán tomarse' = Mandatory. Below 90: actor inferred (impersonal passive).
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 42.- In research classified as greater than minimal risk carried out in women of childbearing age, measures shall be taken to: I. Certify that the women are not pregnant before their acceptance as research subjects, and II. Reduce as far as possible the probabilities of pregnancy during the research.

f.title: Ensure institution and sponsors cover treatment of research harm in subordinate groups
f.statement: In research in subordinate groups, the representatives on the Research Ethics Committee monitor, among other things, that the health-care institution and the sponsors take responsibility for medical treatment of harm caused and, where applicable, the legally due compensation for harmful consequences of the research.
f.clause: Título Segundo, Capítulo V, Artículo 58, fracción III

rows.actor: Health-care institution and sponsor (monitored by Research Ethics Committee representatives)
rows.quote:
III. Que la institución de atención a la salud y los patrocinadores se responsabilicen del tratamiento
médico de los daños ocasionados y, en su caso, de la indemnización que legalmente corresponda por las
consecuencias dañosas de la investigación.
rows.location: Título Segundo, Capítulo V, Artículo 58, fracción III
rows.review_note: Review: no change; Art 58 lead-in: Ethics Committee representatives of the affected group 'vigilarán' (monitor) these conditions. Re-translation: agrees. Below 90: list item; the Ethics Committee monitoring role in the statement comes from the Art 58 lead-in outside the quote; the fraction itself has no verb.
rows.quote_en: III. That the health-care institution and the sponsors take responsibility for the medical treatment of the harm caused and, where applicable, for the compensation legally due for the harmful consequences of the research.

f.title: Apply the Title Three rules to research on new therapeutic resources
f.statement: When research is carried out in human beings on new prophylactic, diagnostic, therapeutic and rehabilitation resources, or modification of known ones is intended, the preceding articles shall be observed as applicable and the provisions of Title Three shall be satisfied.

rows.quote:
ARTICULO 61.- Cuando se realice investigación en seres humanos, sobre nuevos recursos
profilácticos, de diagnóstico, terapéutico y de rehabilitación o se pretenda modificar los ya conocidos,
deberá observarse, en lo aplicable, lo dispuesto en los artículos anteriores y satisfacer lo señalado en
este Título.
rows.review_note: Review: removed the parenthetical pointer to Article 64 from the statement (not in the quote). Re-translation: agrees. Below 90: actor inferred; general applicability rule rather than a discrete PV action.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 61.- When research is carried out on human beings on new prophylactic, diagnostic, therapeutic and rehabilitation resources, or it is intended to modify known ones, the provisions of the preceding articles shall be observed, as applicable, and what is indicated in this Title satisfied.

f.title: Include an objective, complete risk analysis in the protocol submitted for authorisation
f.statement: The research protocol attached to the written application for Secretariat authorisation shall contain an objective and complete analysis of the risks involved, compared with the risks of the established diagnostic and treatment methods and with the expected living conditions of the subject with and without the proposed procedure or treatment.
f.clause: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 62, fracción I

rows.quote:

involucrados, comparados con los riegos de los métodos de diagnóstico y tratamiento

f.title: Describe resources for managing medical emergencies in the authorisation application
f.statement: The application for Secretariat authorisation shall attach a description of the resources available for managing medical emergencies.
f.clause: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 62, fracción V

rows.quote: V.     Descripción de los recursos disponibles para el manejo de urgencias médicas;
rows.location: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 62, fracción V

f.title: Inform the Research Ethics Committee of every related adverse effect
f.statement: In research on new prophylactic, diagnostic, therapeutic and rehabilitation resources, the principal investigator shall inform the Research Ethics Committee of every adverse effect probably or directly related to the research.
f.topic: Adverse event reporting to ethics committee
f.clause: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 64, fracción I
f.applicability: Research under Title Three (new prophylactic, diagnostic, therapeutic and rehabilitation resources, incl. pharmacological research)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.quote:
ARTICULO 64.- En el desarrollo de las investigaciones contempladas en este Título deberán
cumplirse las obligaciones siguientes:

   I.     El investigador principal informará al Comité de Ética en Investigación de todo efecto adverso
          probable o directamente relacionado con la investigación;
rows.location: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 64, fracción I
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'deberán cumplirse las obligaciones siguientes' + 'informará' = Mandatory. Re-translation: agrees. rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 64.- In the conduct of the research covered by this Title, the following obligations shall be complied with: I. The principal investigator will inform the Research Ethics Committee of every adverse effect probably or directly related to the research;

f.title: Notify the Secretariat of any adverse effect within 15 working days
f.statement: The head of the institution, in turn, shall notify the Secretariat of Health of the occurrence of any adverse effect within a maximum of 15 business days following its onset.
f.clause: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 64, fracción II

rows.deadline: Within a maximum of 15 business days (días hábiles) following the onset (presentación) of the adverse effect
rows.location: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 64, fracción II

rows.quote_en: II. The head of the institution, in turn, will notify the Secretariat of the occurrence of any adverse effect within a maximum period of 15 working days following its occurrence;

deadline_rule.applies_to: Any adverse effect in research under Title Three (clock runs from the onset of the adverse effect)

f.title: Suspend or cancel research on an adverse effect that impedes continuation
f.statement: The principal investigator, the Research Ethics Committee, the authorised officials of the health-care institution or the Secretariat shall suspend or cancel the research in the presence of any adverse effect that is an ethical or technical impediment to continuing the study.
f.clause: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 64, fracción III

rows.actor: Principal investigator, Research Ethics Committee, institution officials or the Secretariat
rows.quote:
III.   El investigador principal, el Comité de Ética en Investigación, los funcionarios facultados de la
          institución de atención a la salud de que se trate o la Secretaría, deberán suspender o cancelar la
          investigación ante la presencia de cualquier efecto adverso que sea impedimento desde el punto
          de vista ético o técnico para continuar con el estudio;
rows.location: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 64, fracción III
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actors explicit, 'deberán suspender o cancelar' = Mandatory, statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: III. The principal investigator, the Research Ethics Committee, the authorised officials of the health-care institution concerned or the Secretariat shall suspend or cancel the research in the presence of any adverse effect that is an impediment from the ethical or technical point of view to continuing the study;

f.title: Report suspension or cancellation to the Secretariat within 15 working days
f.statement: The health-care institution shall submit to the Secretariat a report within the 15 working days following the day on which suspension or cancellation of the study was agreed, specifying the effect observed, the measures adopted and the sequelae produced.
f.clause: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 64, fracción IV

rows.deadline: Within the 15 business days (días hábiles) following the day on which the suspension or cancellation was agreed
rows.quote:
IV. La institución de atención a la salud rendirá a la Secretaría un informe dentro de los 15 días
       hábiles siguientes a aquél en que se haya acordado la suspensión o cancelación del estudio, que
       especifique el efecto advertido, las medidas adoptadas y secuelas producidas, y
rows.location: Título Tercero, Capítulo I, Artículo 64, fracción IV
rows.review_note: Review: deadline wording made exact (business days; day zero = day the suspension/cancellation was agreed). Re-translation: agrees. rows.quote_en: IV. The health-care institution will submit to the Secretariat a report within the 15 working days following the day on which the suspension or cancellation of the study was agreed, specifying the effect observed, the measures adopted and the sequelae produced, and

deadline_rule.clock_start: aquél en que se haya acordado la suspensión o cancelación del estudio
deadline_rule.applies_to: Report on suspension or cancellation of a study

f.title: Obtain committee opinion and consent for emergency use of investigational medicines
f.statement: In emergency treatment of life-threatening conditions requiring an investigational medicine, or a known medicine with different indications, doses or routes, the treating physician shall obtain the favourable opinion of the institution's Research and Research Ethics Committees and the informed consent of the subject or legal representative, as circumstances permit.
f.applicability: Emergency, life-threatening use of investigational or off-label medicines

rows.quote:
ARTICULO 71.- En el tratamiento de urgencia en condiciones que amenazan la vida de una persona,
cuando se considere necesario usar un medicamento de investigación o un medicamento conocido
empleando indicaciones, dosis y vías de administración diferentes de las establecidas, el médico tratante
deberá obtener el dictamen favorable de los Comités de Investigación y de Ética en Investigación de la
institución de atención a la salud, así como la carta de consentimiento informado del sujeto de
investigación o, en su caso, de su representante legal, según lo permitan las circunstancias,
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. Actor explicit (médico tratante), 'deberá obtener' = Mandatory, statement adds nothing.
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 71.- In emergency treatment in conditions that threaten a person's life, when it is considered necessary to use an investigational medicine or a known medicine using indications, doses and routes of administration different from those established, the treating physician shall obtain the favourable opinion of the Research and Research Ethics Committees of the health-care institution, as well as the informed consent letter of the research subject or, where applicable, of his or her legal representative, as circumstances permit,

f.title: Inform committees of emergency investigational use in advance or afterwards
f.statement: The Research and Research Ethics Committees shall be informed of the use of an investigational medicine in emergency situations in advance if the investigator can foresee the need, and afterwards if the use, indication, dose or new routes of administration arise as unforeseen needs. In both cases the Committees issue an opinion for or against approving the planned use or the repetition of the unforeseen use.
f.clause: Título Tercero, Capítulo II, Artículo 71, fracción I

rows.deadline: In advance where foreseeable; afterwards for unforeseen use
rows.quote:
I.    Los Comités de Investigación y de Ética en Investigación serán informados del empleo del
         medicamento de investigación de manera anticipada si el investigador puede prever la necesidad
         de su uso en situaciones de urgencia. En forma posterior, si el uso del medicamento, la
         indicación, dosis o vías de administración nuevas surgieran como necesidades no previstas. En
         ambos casos los Comités emitirán el dictamen en favor o en contra de aprobar el uso planeado o
         la repetición del uso no previsto del medicamento, y
rows.location: Título Tercero, Capítulo II, Artículo 71, fracción I

The Research and Research Ethics Committees will be informed of the use of the investigational medicine in advance if the investigator can foresee the need for its use in emergency situations. In both cases the Committees will issue an opinion for or against approving the planned use or the repetition of the unforeseen use of the medicine, and

f.title: Ensure expected benefits always prevail over foreseeable risks
f.statement: Research in human beings shall be conducted so that the probabilities of the expected benefits always prevail over the foreseeable risks.
f.clause: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 14, fracción IV

rows.quote:
IV. Deberán prevalecer siempre las probabilidades de los beneficiados esperados sobre los riesgos
       predecibles;
rows.location: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 14, fracción IV

'Deberán prevalecer' = Mandatory. Below 90: actor inferred; reviewer-written quote_en without independent re-translation; source typo 'beneficiados'.
rows.quote_en: IV. The probabilities of the expected benefits shall always prevail over the foreseeable risks;

f.title: Explain availability of treatment and compensation for research harm in informed consent
f.statement: For informed consent to be considered to exist, the subject or legal representative shall receive a clear and complete explanation of, among other things, the availability of medical treatment and of the compensation to which the subject would legally be entitled from the health-care institution in the event of harm directly caused by the research that warrants it.
f.clause: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 21, fracción X
f.applicability: Informed consent for all research in human beings

rows.quote:
X. La disponibilidad de tratamiento médico y la indemnización a que legalmente tendría derecho, por
parte de la institución de atención a la salud, en el caso de daños que la ameriten, directamente
causados por la investigación, y
rows.location: Título Segundo, Capítulo I, Artículo 21, fracción X
rows.review_note: Review: added by reviewer (companion of row 0004; Art 21 lead-in 'deberá recibir una explicación clara y completa' = Mandatory). rows.quote_en: X. The availability of medical treatment and the compensation to which he or she would legally be entitled, from the health-care institution, in the event of harm warranting it that is directly caused by the research, and

f.title: Obtain consent for emergency investigational use unless incapacity and near-certain risk of death
f.statement: For emergency use of an investigational medicine, the informed consent letter shall be obtained from the research subject or, where applicable, the legal representative or closest relative, except when the subject's condition incapacitates or prevents consent, the legal representative or relative is not available, and not using the investigational medicine represents an almost absolute risk of death.
f.clause: Título Tercero, Capítulo II, Artículo 71, fracción II
f.applicability: Emergency, life-threatening use of investigational or off-label medicines (Art 71)
f.exceptions: Subject unable to consent, representative or relative unavailable, and withholding the medicine carries an almost absolute risk of death

rows.quote:
II.   La carta de consentimiento informado será obtenida del sujeto de investigación, en su aso (sic
         DOF 06-01-1987), de su representante legal o del familiar más cercano en vínculo, excepto
         cuando la condición del sujeto le incapacite o impida otorgarlo, el representante legal o el familiar
         no estén disponibles y el dejar de usar el medicamento de investigación represente un riesgo casi
         absoluto de muerte.
rows.location: Título Tercero, Capítulo II, Artículo 71, fracción II
rows.review_note: Review: added by reviewer (second basis of Art 71 for emergency use; 'será obtenida' = Mandatory with stated exception). Re-translation: own translation, quote_en written by reviewer. Double-check: Translation verified: quote_en re-read against the Spanish; meaning, modal force, numbers and actor agree. 'será obtenida' = Mandatory with exception. Below 90: passive, actor (treating physician) inferred; '(sic DOF 06-01-1987)' annotation inside the quote; reviewer-written quote_en.
rows.quote_en: II. The informed consent letter will be obtained from the research subject or, where applicable, from his or her legal representative or closest relative, except when the subject's condition incapacitates or prevents him or her from giving it, the legal representative or relative is not available, and ceasing to use the investigational medicine represents an almost absolute risk of death.

dates.title: Mexico Health Research Regulation: 2014 reform decree enters into force
dates.scope: Provisions reformed, added or repealed by the decree published in the DOF on 2 April 2014 (including Art. 64 fractions I, III and V and Art. 71); the rest of the Regulation has applied since 1987
dates.quote: TRANSITORIO ÚNICO.- El presente Decreto entrará en vigor al día siguiente de su publicación en el Diario Oficial de la Federación.
dates.quote_en: SOLE TRANSITORY ARTICLE.- This Decree shall enter into force on the day following its publication in the Official Gazette of the Federation (DOF).
dates.location: Artículos transitorios de decretos de reforma, Decree published in the DOF on 2 April 2014
dates.timing_note: Decree published in the DOF 2014-04-02 + 1 day = 2014-04-03. This is the latest reform of the consolidated text; the original Regulation (DOF 6 January 1987, in force the following day) is an earlier version and is not recorded.
